Name of the Surah

• It is called Al-Humazah (The Backbiter), because it opens with a warning to every humazah, that is, one who backbites people and defames them.

From the Objectives of the Surah

• The surah speaks of the mockery of the disbelievers toward the Muslims, their hamz (slandering with the face) and lamz (slandering behind the back), and their preoccupation with gathering wealth, thinking, out of extreme ignorance, that wealth will leave them to live forever in this world. It also describes the severe punishment they will face in the Fire of Hell.

[The Tafsir]

Ruin and destruction for every backbiter of people, every defamer of them.
The one who was preoccupied with gathering wealth and counting it.
It thinks that by this wealth it has gathered, it has secured for itself eternal life in this world and escape from reckoning.
The matter is not as he supposed. He will certainly be thrown into the Fire, which crushes everything that is cast into it.
And what will make you know, O Messenger, what the Fire truly is?
It is the fire of Allah, kindled and intensely blazing, whose heat is so severe that it penetrates from the bodies to the hearts.
